_about: One-time corrections to existing lawsuit rows, applied by inc/lawsuit-updates.php when 'version' changes. Each row matches id AND its current case_name; only the listed fields change, add_source_urls is merged into source_urls, move_facility_links moves the case's link from one record to another, and the note is appended to reviewer_notes once (not again when the file is run under a later version). New cases in seeds/lawsuits.json are inserted in the same pass. An update may name its case by 'match': {docket, name_contains} (or {name_contains, filing_date} for a row with no docket number) instead of id + case_name (only a lone match counts; the replaced values go into the note). 'merge_duplicates' joins second copies of one case (same docket, filing date and court), keeping the row with the full docket number: kop_apply_lawsuit_merges().

updates.case_name: Mattie v. Sequel Youth and Family Services, LLC. et al

set.outcome: Settled. The plaintiff filed a notice of settlement on March 17, 2023; the defendants filed a stipulation of dismissal on April 7, 2023, and the court dismissed the case with prejudice on April 10, 2023 (docket entries 35, 37 and 38). Terms were not filed.
set.summary: Ronald Lewis Mattie, a former employee, filed a civil rights employment discrimination action (nature of suit 442) on December 22, 2021 in the Middle District of Florida against Sequel Youth and Family Services, LLC (served as d/b/a St. John's Youth Academy), SequelCare of Florida, LLC and Sequel TSI of Florida, LLC. It is an employment case, not a case about the youth held there. The plaintiff filed a notice of settlement on March 17, 2023, and the court dismissed the case with prejudice on April 10, 2023 after the parties' stipulation.
